comment: Curated capacity overrides for flagship models whose maker catalog (body_html) never states base capacity — applied ONLY when parsing failed or the unreliable body-mode heuristic fired, never over explicit title/VxAh values. Values are maker-spec watt-hours, corroborated where possible by in-catalog evidence (noted per row) and flagged wh_method='override-curated' in the output for audit. Re-verify each against the maker's spec page at catalog onboarding. Longest/most-specific title match wins.

overrides.note: DELTA Pro Ultra battery/inverter unit = 6,144Wh per maker specs; body-mode gave 6,000/6,144 inconsistently.

DELTA 2 Max = 2,048Wh. In-catalog proof: the same store sells 'DELTA 2 Max + Smart Extra Battery (4kWh)' — station + one 2,048Wh battery = ~4kWh — and body copy says '2-6kWh expandable' (2,048 base, 6,144 max).
DELTA 3 Plus = 1,024Wh maker spec. Body only states its 5kWh expanded max.
DELTA 3 Classic = 1,024Wh; usually explicit in title already.
Plain DELTA 3 = 1,024Wh maker spec (Ultra=3,072 and Max=2,048 are separate models, explicit in their titles).
Same DELTA 3 base unit as above, dual-listed as Solar Generator.
DELTA 2 = 1,024Wh; corroborated by Nov 19 price research ($799 MSRP = $0.78/Wh).
RIVER 3 Plus = 286Wh; in-catalog proof: its Smart Extra Battery rows parse explicitly at 286Wh.
HomePower 2000 Plus = 2,048Wh; in-catalog proof: '(4kWh)' kit listing = station + one battery pack, and body copy states 'a 2048Wh capacity'.
Explorer 1000 v2 = 1,070Wh; corroborated by Nov 19 guide research (wattpicks spec tables). Body copy inconsistently gave 1,024.
